title: Ya-Sin 36:45-48 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:45-48 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 27. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ (٤٥) وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ (٤٦)

وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ (٤٧) وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ (٤٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:45-48 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:45-48 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:45-48 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite all of 36:1 to 48 to a partner.
Link 36:47 to the duty of zakah and sadaqah.
questions.a: Spending from what Allah gave is a right of the poor; the deniers' excuse rejects that right.

questions.q: What do the deniers ask in 36:48?
questions.a: A) When is this promise?. 36:48: 'When is this promise, if you should be truthful?'

questions.q: How many ayat of Ya-Sin have we now learned?
Think again: When told to spend from what Allah gave them, they said: 'Should we feed one whom Allah could feed?' (36:47). What is wrong with that excuse?
questions.a: Allah tests us with wealth; He feeds people through us, and charity is our duty and reward.
